IncidentBot: Pager: customer-impacting quality regression detected for tenant BetaBank in dedicated pool dp-eu-central-1-02. Signal: drop in model_semantic_accuracy by -42% relative to baseline. Model variant: redwood/llama-13b-quant6-profileZ. Alert fired at 2026-04-02T11:00:13Z :rotating_light:

Maya (oncall): seeing this now. Pulling canary logs and last deployment events. Is the tenant VPC-isolated?

Sam (CS): yes, BetaBank is enterprise, VPC peering, ticket BETA-321 opened at 10:58Z. They're seeing PII-like placeholders leaked into account summaries and some numeric fields scrambled. They flagged compliance concerns.

Leo (eng-ml): I rolled profileZ across EU pools yesterday for cost parity. There was a config to exclude "sensitive-tenants" but it didn't match BetaBank label due to tag mismatch. My bad.

Maya (oncall): ok root cause likely profileZ interacting badly with this tokenizer's special-token table. Immediate priorities: limit customer impact (stop bad outputs), maintain availability, and prepare a revert with minimal blast radius.

Priya (ops): quick mitigations:
- apply per-tenant routing override to redwood/llama-13b-fp16-legacy on same pool
- enable request-validation strict mode for BetaBank (drop malformed outputs server-side)
- temporarily throttle non-critical batch requests from the tenant to reduce error amplification

Maya (oncall): ops, can you apply override and validation toggle? Also check capacity headroom on fp16-legacy. If no capacity, we may need to burst to adjacent pool dp-eu-central-1-03.

Priya (ops): running commands now.

```\n# set tenant-level override\nredwoodctl routing set-override --tenant beta-bank-tenant-id --pool dp-eu-central-1-02 --model redwood/llama-13b-fp16-legacy\n# enable strict validation for tenant\nredwoodctl feature-flag set --tenant beta-bank-tenant-id --flag output_validation_strict true\n# optional throttle non-critical endpoints\nredwoodctl quota set --tenant beta-bank-tenant-id --rate \"non_critical=20r/s\"\n```\n
IncidentBot: routing.override.create by priya_ops at 2026-04-02T11:03:02Z

Priya (ops): override applied. validation toggle on. Throttle set for non-critical. Initial telemetry: malformed-output alerts for BetaBank dropped from 28% -> 5% within 60s.

Sam (CS): messaging BetaBank: "We've applied a safe-model routing and strict output validation. You may observe slightly higher latency and rate limits on non-critical paths. We're treating this as top priority and will share an RCA and timeline for a permanent fix." They asked for HIPAA/compliance note; documenting.

Leo (eng-ml): reproduction locally: profileZ uses a custom per-channel quant remapping that compresses special-token embeddings causing collisions for tokens used in BetaBank prompt templates (account_number_placeholder, <SSN>). This leads to decoded tokens that look like PII placeholders. We'll need a corrected profile (profileZ-guarded) that preserves special token embedding fidelity.

Maya (oncall): plan of record: keep per-tenant override and validation for BetaBank until profileZ-guarded is validated. Build guarded profile, run integration across BetaBank redacted prompt set, then canary on non-sensitive tenants, then pool rollout. Timeline estimate 4-6 hours.

Priya (ops): logging this in incident tracker INC-9002. Setting tenant override TTL 48h. Adding automated rule: if dp-eu-central-1-02 error_rate > 12% across tenants, auto-revert profileZ on pool.

Nisha (product): escalate to compliance & account team. We should proactively offer a recorded call and a written summary. Also review rollout gating for VPC/enterprise tenants.

Leo (eng-ml): actionable items for eng-ml: create profileZ-guarded, add tokenizer special-token unit tests, add per-tenant canary exclusion in rollout tool, and bench perf delta. I'll start code change and aim to have a validated artifact in ~3 hours.

Maya (oncall): oncall handoff: I'll hand monitoring to Priya for the next 4 hours. Priya, accept with :thumbsup: so we have a clear owner. Leaving notes: commands used, dashboard links, error samples.

Priya (ops): taking watch. Will post 20m heartbeats. First check-in at 11:20Z. Observability: https://console.redwood/investigate/dp-eu-central-1-02?tenant=beta-bank

Sam (CS): BetaBank response: appreciative of quick mitigation, requested timeline and confirmation that their data wasn't exfiltrated. I'm drafting a customer-safe summary and compliance attestation.

Leo (eng-ml): additional tests: add redacted BetaBank prompt vectors to the quant test harness and run fuzzing across special-token permutations. Also adding guard conditions to quant transformation that prevent embedding weight collisions for tokens in the reserved set.

Maya (oncall): update: after override applied, validation errors down to 3.9%. Latency increased ~9% for BetaBank but within SLO. No other tenants reporting new issues.

Priya (ops): 11:20Z heartbeat: metrics stable, no auto-revert triggered. Resource headroom OK on fp16-legacy; no need to burst. Keeping throttle in place for non-critical endpoints until BetaBank signs off.

Sam (CS): BetaBank asked for an estimated rollback window if guarded profile fails. I told them we can keep override indefinitely but prefer to deploy guarded profile and remove override after validation.

Nisha (product): placing postmortem request. Include: tagging errors during pool-level rollouts, mandatory enterprise-canary step, and a per-pool "skip-enterprise-tenants=on" default.

Priya (ops): noted. Creating follow-up tasks: OPS-312 (audit tenant tags), ROLLOUT-159 (add enterprise-canary gating), ENG-784 (quant transform guard rules).

Leo (eng-ml): dev update: patch pushed to branch profileZ-guarded, unit tests added for special-token stability. Starting CI bench run against small sample of BetaBank vectors. ETA ~2.5 hours to results.

Maya (oncall): summary action items:
- maintain per-tenant override + strict validation (Priya)
- eng-ml to produce profileZ-guarded + tests (Leo)
- CS to send customer comm + compliance note (Sam)
- product to update rollout policy & gating (Nisha)
- ops to monitor pool and auto-revert threshold (Priya)

Priya (ops): acknowledged. Posting 11:40Z heartbeat next.

IncidentBot: oncall handoff recorded: Maya -> Priya at 2026-04-02T11:10:45Z

Priya (ops): 11:40Z heartbeat: BetaBank malformed output alerts holding at 3.2%. No new noisy tenants. Keeping override.

Sam (CS): BetaBank accepted interim mitigation and scheduled a call for 14:00Z CET to review RCA draft.

Maya (oncall): closing this thread for primary triage at 2026-04-02T11:55:13Z. Monitoring continues under Priya. Will add timeline and commands to INC-9002 for postmortem.

IncidentBot: Thread closed by Maya at 2026-04-02T11:55:13Z."
